messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Kanawa muna cikin farin ciki😂😂sarauta tadawo gdanta na gado..uban Abba muna godia 😂😂

output.original_text: Kanawa muna cikin farin ciki😂😂sarauta tadawo gdanta na gado..uban Abba muna godia 😂😂
output.joy: Muna cikin babban farin ciki! 😂😂 Sarautar ta dawo gida na gado! Uban Abba, muna murnar hakan! 😂😂
output.sadness: Duk da cewa muna cikin farin ciki, akwai wani abu cikin zuciyarmu. 😢 Sarautar ta dawo, amma tare da gajiya. Uban Abba, muna godiya. 😢
output.fear: Akwai wata fargaba cikinmu, duk da cewa muna tare da farin ciki. 😟 Sarautar ta dawo, amma da wani hargitsi. Uban Abba, muna godiya, amma... 😟
output.anger: Ina jin haushi! 😡 Sarautar ta dawo, amma a ina ne wannan ya tsaya? Uban Abba, ina son mu nuna jin dadinmu, amma duk wahalar nan! 😡
output.surprise: Abin mamaki! 😲 Sarautar ta dawo gida na gado! Uban Abba, ba mu zaton wannan zai faru ba! 😲
output.disgust: Wannan ba ya kyau! 🤢 Sarautar ta dawo, amma ba tare da ɗan jin daɗi ba. Uban Abba, abin ba ya yi kyau ko kadan! 🤢
